items.z: 我一般会在马桶上看书。

items.e: I was almost hit by a lorry.
items.z: 我差点被卡车撞到。

items.e: The murmur of the brook lulls me to sleep.
items.z: 溪流潺潺，催我入眠。

items.e: We are currently lacking good quality building lumber.
items.z: 现在正缺良好的建筑木材。

items.e: He acted like a lunatic.
items.z: 他表现的像个疯子。

items.e: What is lurking in the shadows?
items.z: 谁在影子里藏着？

items.e: The valley was lush with tall grass and wild flowers.
items.z: 山谷里长满高高的野草和野花，一片苍翠。

items.e: An electric current can generate magnetism.
items.z: 电流可以产生磁性。

items.e: The Titanic's maiden voyage didn't go so well.
items.z: 泰塔尼克号的首航不是很好的。

items.e: Tomorrow, I am coming back from Hong Kong to the mainland.
items.z: 明天我要从香港去趟内地。

items.e: He majors in English literature.
items.z: 他主修英国文学。

items.e: The repair for the system malfunction lasted for an entire night.
items.z: 系统故障的修复工作持续了一整个晚上。

items.e: There was no malice intended in what she said.
items.z: 她的话没有恶意。

items.e: What was at first a natural disaster rapidly became a man-made debacle.
items.z: 起初的天灾迅速演变为了人祸。

items.e: Do you know the Heimlich maneuver?
items.z: 你知道海姆利克急救法吗？

items.e: If you use this modern equipment, it will save a lot of manpower.
items.z: 如果人们使用这些现代化的机器, 那将节省很多人力。

items.e: She used margarine instead of butter.
items.z: 她用人造黄油代替了黄油。

items.e: Poor transport can marginalize people who live far away.
items.z: 交通不便会让住在远处的人被边缘化。

items.e: The marina was full of small white boats.
items.z: 码头停满了白色的小船。

items.e: The invention of the transistor marked a new era.
items.z: 晶体管的发明标志着一个新时代的开始。

items.e: It is really marvelous of you to remember my birthday.
items.z: 你还记得我的生日，那真是太好了。

items.e: The team mascot is a friendly brown bear.
items.z: 球队的吉祥物是一只友善的棕熊。

items.e: Our team suffered a massacre in the final match.
items.z: 我们队在决赛中惨败。

items.e: We've been matched up with some strong teams this year.
items.z: 我们今年和不少强队交过手。

items.e: Maternal love is greater than anything else.
items.z: 母爱比任何别的东西都伟大。

items.e: He grew a beard to look more mature.
items.z: 他留了胡子，为了让自己看起来更成熟。

items.e: Life without love is meaningless.
items.z: 没有爱的人生没有意义。

items.e: Sami has just been to the mechanic.
items.z: 萨米刚去找了技工。

items.e: I got a piece of lead for my mechanical pencil from her.
items.z: 我从她那里拿了一根自动铅笔芯。
